_help: Approved service descriptions. Keep wording factual. No cure claims, no guaranteed results, no prices unless the clinic provides them.
_complianceReview: Before launch, have the clinic confirm FDA wording (FDA-cleared vs approved) for Exomind and V-Tone, and the safety/contraindication text.

services.name: Exomind
services.summary: Exomind is a non-invasive brain stimulation treatment that uses magnetic pulses (ExoTMS). It is offered to support mood, focus and emotional balance.
services.details: Sessions are about 30 minutes with no downtime. A typical plan is about 6 sessions over 3-6 weeks; the provider confirms the plan at consultation. Not suitable for people with metal implants in the head or who are pregnant.

services.name: Aging Biohacking
services.summary: Personalized longevity and performance programs. Specific protocols are set by the clinic's providers.

services.name: V-Tone
services.summary: V-Tone is a non-invasive electrical muscle stimulation treatment used to strengthen pelvic floor muscles.
services.details: Sessions are about 30 minutes; a series is typically recommended. The provider determines if it is appropriate.

services.name: IV Therapy
services.summary: IV micronutrient therapy, NAD+ IV therapy, custom blends and performance booster IVs.

services.name: Regenerative Medicine
services.summary: Joint and musculoskeletal injections, Clarity Direct neurofeedback, cold exposure therapy and salt therapy.

services.name: Hormone Therapy
services.summary: Hormone replacement therapy, including testosterone therapy for men, personalized and monitored by the clinic's providers.

services.name: Weight Loss Programs
services.summary: Programs that may include semaglutide injections, brown fat activation, IV exosome therapy and metabolic testing, tailored by a provider.

services.name: Chiropractic & Physical Therapy
services.summary: Spinal decompression, chiropractic adjustments, posture correction therapy, and shockwave and laser therapy.

services.name: Membership plans
services.summary: Membership plans give preferred rates on services. Details and pricing are provided by the office; offer a call back.
